title: Complex chromoelectric polarizability of a heavy-quarkonium resonance: pole response and channel-resolved effective-theory representation
summary: For a stable compact quarkonium state in the pNRQCD multipole regime, chromoelectric polarizability arises at leading order from two E1 transitions through virtual color-octet states. For an unstable state, we define the corresponding response through the quadratic displacement of its complex resonance pole in a weak chromoelectric background, so that its real and imaginary parts describe field-induced shifts of the pole mass and width.
